definitions.explanation: Weather condition when clouds cover the sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{曇|くも}り⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{曇|くも}り⟦のち→後：03545_nochi⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦でしょう→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧。
examples.english: Tomorrow will be cloudy, then rain.

notes:
{曇|くも}り describes cloudy weather or cloudiness.

WRITING:
Both read くも but use different kanji:
- {曇|くも}り: cloudy weather
- ⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧: cloud
The kanji differ by their radicals (sun vs rain).

WEATHER TERMS:
- ⟦{晴|は}れ→晴れ：02936_hare⟧: sunny
- {曇|くも}り: cloudy
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: rain
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧: snow

WEATHER FORECAST EXPRESSIONS:
- {曇|くも}り⟦のち→後：03545_nochi⟧⟦{晴|は}れ→晴れ：02936_hare⟧: cloudy then sunny
- {曇|くも}り⟦のち→後：03545_nochi⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: cloudy then rain
- {曇|くも}り⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: cloudy with occasional rain
- {曇|くも}り⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: cloudy with brief rain

RELATED VERB:
- ⟦{曇|くも}る→曇る：00723_kumoru⟧: to become cloudy, to cloud over
- ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{曇|くも}る→曇る：00723_kumoru⟧: the sky clouds over
